customer.title: Customer
customer.description: Optional UUID reference to a Pipelinq contact (the natural person at the till). Distinct from the optional client (account) reference. Required when tenderType is 'onAccount' so the sale can be tracked as a debtor entry.

marketingConsent.title: Marketing consent
marketingConsent.description: Whether the customer opted in to marketing at the point of sale. Captured per transaction and, when sync is enabled, mirrored onto the linked contact. Never overrides a contact flagged do-not-contact.

tenderType.title: Tender type
tenderType.description: How the transaction was paid. 'onAccount' (op rekening) defers payment to a debtor ledger and requires a customer.

marketingConsent.title: Marketing consent
marketingConsent.description: Whether this contact opted in to receiving offers and updates. Set from the POS consent checkbox when Pipelinq sync is enabled.

doNotContact.title: Do not contact
doNotContact.description: Privacy flag. When true the contact must not be approached for marketing; POS search marks the contact and consent sync is skipped.
